## Checklist

- [ ] The change is in the scope of [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sorge-it/cdp-browser-installer/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope).
- [ ] A test fails without the change, or the change touches only documentation.
- [ ] `composer test` passes, or fails only in the new test of a bug report.
- [ ] For a bug, the description names the platform and the output of `php -v`, `curl --version` and `unzip -v`.
